en.headline: Kowloon Funeral Parlour sold for HK$473 million to local consortium
en.dek: The nearly 70-year-old Tai Kok Tsui premises, once the site of Bruce Lee’s public funeral, changed hands along with its business operations and an adjoining warehouse.
body: The Kowloon Funeral Parlour in Tai Kok Tsui has been sold for HK$473 million to a consortium of local investors and industry figures, according to property reports. The deal includes the three-storey building with a gross floor area of nearly 40,000 square feet and 16 halls, as well as the operating business and a nearby factory unit used as a warehouse.

The seller was Jeff Kong, major shareholder of Red Rabbit Capital, who had acquired the property for HK$590 million in 2016 and earlier sought about HK$600 million. The buyer group includes industry operator Po Hing-cheung of Wing Fook Shing and Chuen Fook Shing Funeral Service; he declined to comment, citing a confidentiality agreement.

Built in 1958, the parlour hosted Bruce Lee’s public funeral in 1973, which drew more than 20,000 mourners. In recent years it has held public open days. The transaction was reported as the premises and business changed hands amid the seventh lunar month.

zh.headline: 九龍殯儀館4.73億元易主 曾送別李小龍
zh.dek: 大角咀近70年歷史殯儀館連同營運生意及鄰近貨倉，售予本地金主與業界人士合組財團。
body: 據物業消息，大角咀九龍殯儀館以4.73億元易手，買家為本地投資者與殯儀業界人士組成的財團。交易包括樓高三層、總樓面約4萬平方呎、設16個禮堂的物業，以及整條營運業務和鄰近用作倉庫的工業單位。
賣方為赤兔資本大股東江龍章，他於2016年以5.9億元購入，早前開價約6億元。買家包括經營永福盛及全福盛殯儀的布興祥；他以保密協議為由拒絕置評。
九龍殯儀館於1958年啟用，1973年曾舉行李小龍公開殯禮，吸引逾2萬人到場。近年館方曾舉辦公眾開放日。交易適逢農曆七月期間完成。
